notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent with toughness 3 or greater.
easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Arbor Adherent has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Arbor Adherent using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.
